name: @eslint/jsinspect
description: A web app for inspecting how @eslint/jsparse, @eslint/jsscope, and @eslint/jsflow see a program.

scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsparse && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsscope && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsflow
scripts.prebuild: npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsparse && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsscope && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsflow
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsparse && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsscope && npm run build --workspace=@eslint/jsflow
